- Total revenue across all countries reached £124,404.10 TW, representing a +2.6% WoW increase from £121,297.26 LW, despite a -21.5% YoY decline.

- United Kingdom maintained rank 1 with revenue of £94,054.57 TW and a 75.6% share TW, but experienced a -17.4% WoW decrease and generated 250 orders TW compared to 264 LW.

- Australia achieved rank 2 with revenue of £16,726.84 TW and a 13.4% share TW, driven by exceptional growth of +3954.5% WoW from £412.55 LW and +4139.0% YoY from £394.59 LY.

- Finland secured rank 3 with revenue of £4,418.02 TW and a 3.6% share TW, supported by strong momentum of +2575.0% WoW.

- Germany experienced the largest WoW decline among tracked countries with revenue of £1,433.78 TW, representing a -47.5% WoW decrease from £2,728.99 LW.

- EIRE recorded the largest YoY decrease with revenue of £11,352.29 LY, indicating a -67.6% YoY contraction in the current period.
